summary: Umpqua NF tower built in the 1930s on a spur west of the summit in Douglas County, OR; now gone, and no source describes what remains.

facts.location: Umpqua National Forest, Douglas County, Oregon
facts.status_note: Tower listed as gone; no source gives a removal date or describes what remains on the spur

access.note: No source we read says whether visitors may go to the spur

facts.agency: U.S. Forest Service, Umpqua National Forest

events.note: Registered March 29, 2011 as US 903, OR 270; nominated by Ray Kresek

evidence.supports: tower built in the 1930s atop a spur west of the summit; now gone
evidence.quote: Built in the 1930s atop a spur west of the summit, this tower is now gone.

evidence.supports: listed among Douglas County sites with survey location 24S-2W-32
Forest Lookouts lists the site under the Douglas County heading

notes_for_editor: Thin record: only the register, Forest Lookouts (location only) and firelookout.com were read, and none gives a build year beyond the 1930s, a design, a removal date or staffing. The brief's second coordinate pair (43.531, -122.9609, from west_us_lookouts) is about 10 km north of the FFLOS point (43.44396, -122.95672); that other source was not read. A rough check puts the FFLOS point about 25 miles from Roseburg, close to firelookout.com's 26 miles, so the FFLOS point is kept. Check the other source before any map change. No photos added.
